events.summary: Ugin tells Jace that the hedrons' purpose is to imprison the Eldrazi; Jace asks how that worked out last time.
events.quote: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned." "And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

events.summary: Gerrard's final act ensures his legacy never dies.
events.quote: Gerrard's final act ensured his legacy would never die.

events.summary: The merfolk's gods Ula, Emeria and Cosi turn out to be false memories of the Eldrazi titans.
events.quote: The gods known to the merfolk as Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were nothing more than false memories of a monstrous trinity: the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Emrakul, and Kozilek.

events.summary: Elves find a use for every part of the Eldrazi.
events.quote: It wasn't long until the elves had developed a use for every part of the Eldrazi.

events.summary: The Planeswalker Chandra visits and is unimpressed with a place.
events.quote: The more I see of this place, the less I want to.

relations.note: Ugin discusses the hedrons' purpose with Jace.

relations.note: Ula was a false memory of Ulamog among the merfolk.
relations.quote: The gods known to the merfolk as Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were nothing more than false memories of a monstrous trinity: the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Emrakul, and Kozilek.
There are no soloists in the chorus of Selesnya.

relations.note: Dovin Baan speaks of Senate personnel.
relations.quote: Mandatory lockets enable the tracking of all Senate personnel for improved security and efficiency.
